# R.R Studio

> An independent design and technology studio for contemporary art galleries: small tools that work inside the gallery's own accounts, and done-for-you digital work at a fixed price per task. No retainers, no hourly billing.

R.R Studio (an extension of Vitreen Software) makes technology work for contemporary art galleries, from solo gallerists to established teams. It offers two things: tools that bring artwork information into the gallery's everyday workflow (Gmail, WhatsApp and the systems it already uses), and fixed-price tasks on the gallery's website, artwork inventory, sales material and online visibility.

Contact: studio@rrstudio.online
Location: Paris, France
Website: https://www.rrstudio.online (French: https://www.rrstudio.online/fr)

## Tools

- Chat — sends works and PDF selections to collectors, right from WhatsApp.
- Mail — finds the work a collector asks about and adds it to the gallery's Gmail reply.
- Assistant — a morning brief that tells the gallery who is waiting for a reply.
- Inventory — keeps every work, its images and its availability in one record.

Tools are not self-serve. Every gallery works differently, so each tool starts with a short call: the gallery sends a request from the "Let's talk" link on the tool's card (gallery name, email, and where its works live today), R.R Studio replies by email to plan the call, and the setup is decided together after it.

## Tasks: how it works

1. Choose one or more tasks on the site; the estimate shows the fixed price upfront. Send the request and what's needed (text, images, links, exports or access details) by email.
2. R.R Studio confirms scope, completes the task and human-checks every detail.
3. R.R Studio delivers the finished work by email for review. Payment happens after approval; if the agreed outcome isn't delivered, the task is refunded.

No subscription, no retainer. Works with a gallery's existing tools (current website, Artlogic, spreadsheets, shared files).

## Tasks and pricing (fixed price per task, EUR)

### Website
- Publish an exhibition — €120 — text, images and dates turned into a published exhibition page.
- Prepare for an opening — €220 — homepage, exhibition and artist pages refreshed and ready before opening.
- Add an artist page — €90 — biography, works, images and basic metadata added to the gallery website.
- Update 10 artworks — €90 — update images, captions, availability or other artwork information.
- Fix a website issue — €90 — investigate and fix one defined issue.

### Inventory
- Organise your inventory — €150 — clean categories, fields and structure.
- Import 50 artworks — €220 — clean and import a spreadsheet or export.
- Clean 50 artwork records — €180 — fix inconsistent artwork information.
- Clean up your Artlogic inventory — €120 — remove duplicates, complete missing records and make the inventory reliable again.

### Sales material
- Collector PDF — €80 — a clean, gallery-ready PDF prepared from selected artworks.
- Private viewing room — €120 — prepare and publish a private online artwork selection for a collector.

### Visibility
- Artist Google indexing — €120 — find the main issues keeping an artist page out of Google.

## Who it's for

Contemporary art galleries that want their digital work done, and better everyday tools, without hiring in-house or paying an agency retainer. R.R Studio works alongside a gallery's existing website and systems rather than replacing them.
